name: mimo_web_search
description: Search the live web using Xiaomi MiMo official Web Search (OpenAI-compatible API). Returns factual results with source URLs and summaries. Use for: current events, trending data, product info, technical questions, any real-time information. The source annotations often contain the exact data you need — always check them.

query.description: Search query. Be specific. Include dates, version numbers, or "today" for time-sensitive queries.

limit.description: Max search results. Default: 10. More results = higher chance of finding specific data.

max_keyword.description: Max parallel search keywords. Higher = broader but slower. Default: 5.

force_search.description: Force web search even if model thinks it can answer directly. Default: true.
